verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a unified candidate profile that brings resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history and consent status into one record. What is shown are separate API and MCP operations: creating ratings, retrieving candidate files, listing offers and listing events. These are adjacent building blocks rather than the unified-record capability itself, and email threads and consent status are not mentioned at all.

support.subject: As a recruiter, every candidate has one unified profile — resume, email threads, interview feedback, activity history, and consent status in a single record
